tutorial.welcomeDesc: Master English vocabulary with AI-driven insights and spaced repetition.
tutorial.searchDesc: Search massive word collections to see definitions, Chinese translations, and contextual inflections.
tutorial.historyDesc: Your word journey is automatically saved. Organised by time for easy review.
tutorial.reviewDesc: Our smart algorithm helps you review words at the perfect moment for long-term memory.
tutorial.settingsDesc: Customise daily goals and notifications to stay on track.
tutorial.listsDesc: We provide curated word lists for different levels. Add words to your daily review session!
tutorial.pwaDesc: Install WordDaily for a seamless, app-like experience with notifications and quick access.
tutorial.pwaChromeAndroidStep1: 1. Tap the three vertical dots ( ⋮ ) in the top right corner.
tutorial.pwaChromeAndroidStep2: 2. Select 'Install App' or 'Add to Home Screen'.
tutorial.pwaChromePCStep1: 1. Click the 'Install' icon in the address bar or the ( ⋮ ) menu.
tutorial.pwaChromeIPadStep1: 1. Tap the 'Share' icon (square with arrow) in the top right corner.
tutorial.pwaChromeIPadStep2: 2. Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
tutorial.pwaSafariIPhoneStep1: 1. Tap the three dots ( ... ) in the bottom right corner.
tutorial.pwaSafariIPhoneStep3: 3. Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
tutorial.pwaSafariIPadStep1: 1. Tap the 'Share' icon (square with arrow) in the top right corner.
tutorial.pwaSafariIPadStep2: 2. Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
tutorial.pwaSafariStep3: 3. Confirm by tapping 'Add' at the top right.
tutorial.pwaRecommend: Strongly RECOMMENDED: Use Chrome or Safari for the best experience.
